title: Knowledge Graphs as Files: An Agent Harness Where Tool Creation and Tool Use Co-Evolve
abstract: arXiv:2610.18616v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Searching text-rich knowledge graphs requires following relations while examining textual evidence. Predefined graph interfaces constrain what evidence agents can access, even when they write code to combine tool calls or process retrieved subgraphs. We propose direct knowledge graph interaction (DKGI), a harness in which language model agents create graph access tools directly over complete node and edge files. The agent writes Python code to follow relations, combine node sets, and select textual evidence, interleaving execution with shell search and file inspection. This lets agents process large node sets in bulk while returning selected text for the model to assess. Execution feedback guides tool creation and revision, while the evolving tools determine what evidence the agent gathers next. On benchmark datasets spanning three domains, training-free DKGI exceeds the strongest published baseline by at least 6.7 Hit@1 points on ever

translated_title: 知识图谱即文件：一种工具创建与工具使用协同演化的智能体框架
translated_abstract: 搜索富文本知识图谱需要在遍历关系的同时审阅文本证据。预定义的图接口限制了智能体所能访问的证据范围，即使智能体编写代码来组合工具调用或处理检索到的子图也是如此。我们提出直接知识图谱交互，这是一种让语言模型智能体直接基于完整的节点和边文件创建图访问工具的框架。智能体通过编写Python代码来遍历关系、合并节点集合并筛选文本证据，将代码执行与shell搜索和文件检查交替进行。这使智能体能够批量处理大型节点集合，同时返回筛选后的文本供模型评估。执行反馈指导工具的创建与修订，而不断演化的工具又决定了智能体接下来收集哪些证据。在跨越三个领域的基准数据集上，无需训练的DKGI超过最强已发表基线至少6.7个Hit@1点。
tldr: 提出DKGI框架，让语言模型智能体将知识图谱视为完整的节点和边文件直接交互，通过编写Python代码自行创建和修订图访问工具，实现工具创建与工具使用的协同演化，在三个领域的基准上无需训练即超越最强基线至少6.7个Hit@1点。
